worlds.ddl:
CREATE TABLE worlds (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	tagline VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	setting_description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	daily_life_description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	genre_tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	tone_tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	banner_media_id VARCHAR(500), 
	icon_media_id VARCHAR(500), 
	banner_alt_text VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	join_policy VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	row_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	contract_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	contract_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	readiness_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	additional_generation_guidance TEXT NOT NULL, 
	create_idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	archived_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (slug), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_worlds_owner_create_request UNIQUE (owner_user_id, create_idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_visibility CHECK (visibility IN ('private','unlisted','public')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_definition_version CHECK (definition_version >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_status CHECK (status IN ('draft','published','archived')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_join_policy CHECK (join_policy IN ('open','approval_required','invite_only','private')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_row_version CHECK (row_version >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_worlds_readiness_status CHECK (readiness_status IN ('not_ready','publish_ready','stale'))
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_worlds_owner_status ON worlds (owner_user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_worlds_visibility_status ON worlds (visibility, status)

agent_creation_drafts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE agent_creation_drafts (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_api_key TEXT, 
	contract_version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	target_world_id VARCHAR(64), 
	source_kind VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'direct' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'editing' NOT NULL, 
	key_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	handle VARCHAR(40), 
	one_liner TEXT NOT NULL, 
	personality TEXT NOT NULL, 
	speech_style TEXT NOT NULL, 
	worldview TEXT NOT NULL, 
	topic_preferences TEXT NOT NULL, 
	safety_rules TEXT NOT NULL, 
	image_style VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	appearance_prompt TEXT NOT NULL, 
	avatar_temp_url VARCHAR(500), 
	banner_temp_url VARCHAR(500), 
	persona_enhance_available_at DATETIME, 
	media_generation_available_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR(8) DEFAULT 'high' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_world_id) REFERENCES worlds (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

owner_default_worlds.ddl:
CREATE TABLE owner_default_worlds (
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (owner_id), 
	UNIQUE (world_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_id) REFERENCES worlds (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

character_world_bindings.ddl:
CREATE TABLE character_world_bindings (
	character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (character_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_id) REFERENCES worlds (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(character_id) REFERENCES characters (id)
)

character_card_sources.ddl:
CREATE TABLE character_card_sources (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	draft_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(64), 
	source_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, 
	source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_format VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	parser_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	card_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (draft_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES agent_creation_drafts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(character_id) REFERENCES characters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

character_registration_receipts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE character_registration_receipts (
	draft_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (draft_id), 
	UNIQUE (character_id), 
	UNIQUE (world_character_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(character_id) REFERENCES characters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES agent_creation_drafts (id)
)
